metrics.profile_summary: Digital marketing professional with over 2 years of experience specializing in social media management, performance marketing, and content creation. Proven track record of managing diverse brand portfolios and implementing data-driven growth strategies.

experience.description: Leads digital operations and social media strategies for multiple brands, coordinating video content and managing PR and performance marketing support.
Managed social media, content, and performance marketing; handled Shopify, web analytics, graphic design, and customer query resolution.
Managed order bookings and customer complaints via phone and online channels.

strengths: Strong social media and content management experience
Graphic design and video content coordination skills
Proficiency in performance marketing and web analytics
weaknesses: Does not possess a completed Bachelor's degree in Marketing or Mass Communication
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a strong technical match with direct experience in all core job responsibilities, including social media management and asset coordination. While he lacks the formal degree requirement, his professional track record and certifications make him a highly viable candidate.
